name: vscode-claude-rtl
description: Right-to-left (Hebrew/Arabic) support for the Claude Code chat sidebar, with a floating AUTO / RTL / LTR panel.
author: Shalom Levi

claudeCodeRtl.autoApply.description: Automatically (re)apply the RTL patch on startup and after Claude Code updates. Turn off to manage it manually with the commands.

claudeCodeRtl.defaultMode.markdownDescription: Initial direction mode for the floating panel, used until you change it in the panel (the panel remembers your choice afterwards in the webview's `localStorage`).

claudeCodeRtl.stripEscapedBidi.markdownDescription: Hide literal bidi-escape text (the six ASCII characters `\u200F`, `\u200E`, `\u200B`) that the model sometimes emits into chat prose. Display-only — the transcript is untouched, and text inside code blocks, inline code and the composer is never altered.
